missable.body: Positive Mental Attitude is the only missable trophy. It asks you to meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, and one spot — Lucia's balcony — is only reachable during Chapter 1. It disappears once the chapter ends, and GTA VI has no mission replay, so a playthrough that finishes Chapter 1 without it cannot earn the trophy. Do the balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1 and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter as insurance.
missable.source: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List; KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
missable.title: Missable trophies: 1 of 55

rules: No online trophies: all 55 are single-player.
No difficulty trophies and no mission medals.
No mission replay and no New Game Plus: manual saves are your only safety net.
Platinum time is roughly 200 hours — long grinds, not hard ones.
Cheats switch trophies off: play clean while hunting.

stages.detail: Chapters 1, 2, 3 and 4, the named missions (Gone Fishing, Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) and the final mission. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: there is no mission replay.
stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 1–4 + finale
stages.warning: Do the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends — it is the only missable trophy.

stages.detail: Finish all 8 stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and two more), the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) and the quiet moments (Ocean Beach cocktail, second-try luck).
stages.title: Strangers, partners & the open world
stages.warning: Start every stranger strand as soon as its icon appears; later missions only unlock after the earlier ones.

stages.detail: 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 vehicles, all 52 areas, 8 garages, 5 bank vaults, 1 armored truck, 1 illegal operation per gang (9), $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, 10 Scooter Bros registrations.
stages.title: Collectibles, robberies & exploration
stages.warning: Sweep district by district — scan, discover and rob as you travel, and the counts climb together.

stages.detail: 250 stunts, 42 gold Shooting Range challenges, 14 drone-race wins, 20 race wins, fishing vs Cal, one arcade game, bowling, 18 meditation spots, 50 challenges, 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus.
stages.title: Activities & grinds
stages.warning: Unlock the full weapon set before grinding the Shooting Range; sample all 9 activity types for Master of None.

stages.detail: Finish the 500-choice count, mop up any remaining collectibles, then check the in-game 100% checklist. A Long Road (gold) pops at 100% — and the Platinum follows the moment it does.
stages.title: Cleanup & 100% completion
stages.warning: The in-game stats page shows exactly which checklist tasks have no trophy of their own.

subtitle: Five stages, built from the official trophy descriptions. Story first, then strangers, then collectibles, then the activity grinds, and finally 100% completion.
title: Roadmap to the Platinum
